name: Hudson Bend Colony
title: Hudson Bend Colony Window Cleaning, Lake Travis | CleanzATX
description: Window cleaning in Hudson Bend Colony No 1 and No 2, where old cabins give way to $1M+ homes. Pure water, no ladders on exterior glass.
h1_em: Old cabins, new builds, clean glass.
intro: Hudson Bend Colony is the original plat on the peninsula, and older cabins here are being replaced by homes worth $1M and up. CleanzATX cleans windows for both kinds of house, using pure water and published prices that stay the same.

sections.h2: What Hudson Bend Colony homes are like
paragraphs: The Colony is made up of two original plats, No 1 and No 2, with several hundred lots between Pool Canyon and Hudson Bend Road. There is no HOA and no gate. For decades it was a place for small cabins and weekend homes, and plenty of those are still standing. Some lots back up to wooded land, and others have a view of the lake between neighbors. That is the kind of detail we look at before we quote.

What shifts the picture is new construction. Buyers are removing older cabins and building homes that sell for $1M and more, so on some streets a new house sits beside a worn one. That mix tells you what kind of cleaning each place needs. If you are buying a Colony cabin to rebuild, we are glad to clean the glass of the home you move into while the new one goes up.

sections.h2: What Hudson Bend Colony windows deal with
paragraphs: Older cabins usually have smaller windows, older frames, deep tracks and screens that have not been cleaned in years. New builds bring big panes, construction dust and fresh irrigation. Both kinds sit close to the lake, so hard water spotting is the common thread. Cedar pollen from December to February and live oak pollen in March and April land on all of it. Sprinklers on new lawns make things worse on the lower panes.

Where spots have sat for years, they can etch into glass. We say so up front and charge $10 per pane for removal. Where there is only dust and pollen, regular pure water cleaning usually does it. Screens and tracks at $5 each help older windows glide open again. We will show you the difference on one window if you want to see it first.

sections.h2: How we work Hudson Bend Colony
paragraphs: No gate and no HOA mean easy access. We bring our own pure water, so you do not need to hook anything up. We work from the ground with water fed poles, which matters on older cabins where we do not want ladders leaning on aging trim. We keep the old and new homes on one route when we can. If a cabin has siding or a deck that needs washing, a soft wash is the gentle option.

A 3,000 sq ft rebuild comes to about $300 for exterior windows. A small cabin may fall under our $200 minimum. We estimate by text and tell you before booking. Allow roughly two to three hours on site for a house that size.

why: Original plat with both old cabins and new $1M homes, so we price by size
Old frames and tracks need care, not only a spray
No HOA and no gate, so access is easy
Lake closeness means hard water spots we know how to treat

faq.q: Will you clean an older cabin with small windows?
faq.a: Yes. Pricing is $10 per window, and a small cabin may fall under our $200 minimum. We tell you that when we quote by text, so there are no surprises. We would rather be upfront than send a short bill that surprises you.

faq.q: Can you clean a new build after the crew leaves?
faq.a: Yes. Final construction dust and residue are common on new homes. We look at the glass first and say what can be removed safely. If anything is left, we text you a photo and talk it through.

faq.q: Do you work near Pool Canyon?
faq.a: Yes. Pool Canyon and Hudson Bend Road are part of our regular Hudson Bend coverage. Text your neighborhood and a photo, and we send a quote. We usually group visits by street, which helps keep the schedule tight.

faq.q: Is there an HOA I need to ask first?
faq.a: The Colony has no HOA, so you only need to decide when you want us. We can usually get you on the calendar inside two weeks. We still ask for a day that suits you, and we confirm the time by text.

faq.q: Can you also wash the siding on my cabin?
faq.a: Yes. Soft washing a house starts at $0.20 per sq ft, $400 minimum. We use low pressure, which is safer for older siding, wood trim and painted surfaces. Gutters and screens are priced separately, and we can add them to the same visit.
